issues.quote: It has always been troublesome. Aunt Odile was embarrassed for me
issues.fact: F1 gives only a single offset: at the nine o'clock bell the watch showed twenty minutes to nine. The sheet says nothing about the watch being unreliable or its error varying.
issues.misreading: A solver could read 'troublesome' and 'never let anyone regulate it' as saying the watch's error drifts unpredictably. That would make the 20-minute correction unreliable for the 10:15, 10:18, 10:21 and 10:32 readings, so the watch-to-temple conversion would be uncertain even though the sheet gives it as fixed.

issues.quote: I had brandy, several glasses, I will be honest.
issues.fact: The sheet says only that he went to the library and stayed there alone. It does not mention drinking.
issues.misreading: The drinking, and later 'I was not drunk', could be taken to mean his perception of the sounds and of the time is impaired. That casts doubt on the 10:18 thump, the repeater count and the 10:15 and 10:21 movements, none of which the sheet qualifies.
